articles.title: Singer Sombr Brings Out His Music Hero
articles.summary: At a concert in Los Angeles, Sombr surprised fans by bringing out Lindsey Buckingham of Fleetwood Mac.

articles.title: An Old Space Game Is Coming Back
articles.summary: A video game producer announced a new, improved version of the 1990s space game Wing Commander 3.

articles.title: Try This Eye Trick: See Colors That Are Not There
articles.summary: Stare at a colored picture, then look at something white, and you will see a ghostly image in different colors.
